services.name: Reiki in West Linn, Oregon
services.desc: Reiki at The Gathering Place is more than energy work-it’s a return to your own inner rhythm. In a world that often pulls us outward, Reiki offers a path back to your center, inviting your nervous system to soften, your breath to deepen, and your spirit to remember its natural pace. Whether you’re navigating emotional overwhelm, physical imbalance, spiritual disconnection, or simply the fatigue that comes from doing too much for too long, Reiki provides a non-invasive and deeply intuitive space for recalibration. It gently restores flow where there’s been stagnation, and ease where there’s been tension-offering healing that unfolds organically, often in ways that words alone cannot touch.

services.name: Massage in West Linn, Oregon
services.desc: Massage therapy at The Gathering Place is an invitation to slow down and return to the wisdom of your physical self. Ideal for those holding chronic tension, emotional overwhelm, or deep fatigue, this work offers a gentle yet powerful pathway to presence. Liesl Molnar offers integrative bodywork sessions that weave together Swedish and deep tissue massage, myofascial release, craniosacral therapy, breathwork, and intuitive touch. Each session is uniquely tailored to support your body’s current needs-whether that’s relief from pain, grounding after emotional stress, or simply a moment to exhale and feel held.
